title: -(으)니까 causa
part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태
articleMarkdown:
#### En pocas palabras

The NIKL guide describes **-(으)니까** as a reason/cause connective and contrasts it with **-아서/어서**: it allows a following suggestion or command in examples such as “비가 오니까 여행을 취소하자,” whereas the corresponding -아서/어서 construction is disallowed. The scope here is that contrast and these documented functions.

#### Fuentes y localizadores

National Institute of Korean Language. (s. f.). *한국어교육 문법·표현 내용 개발 연구(3단계) [Research on the Development of Korean Grammar and Expression Content (Stage 3)]*. https://www.korean.go.kr/common/download.do;front=B5CD4F10151810563982D51A3FD4329B?c_file_name=5a2db2bc-a7ad-49f4-84a4-34b20ad33ffc_0.pdf&file_path=reportData&o_file_name=%ED%95%9C%EA%B5%AD%EC%96%B4%EA%B5%90%EC%9C%A1+%EB%AC%B8%EB%B2%95%ED%91%9C%ED%98%84+%EB%82%B4%EC%9A%A9%EA%B0%9C%EB%B0%9C+%EC%97%B0%EA%B5%AC_3%EB%8B%A8%EA%B3%84.pdf

Research on the Development of Korean Grammar and Expression Content (Stage 3), PDF pp. 27 and 278–280 (printed pp. 26 and 266–268): comparison with -어서/-기 때문에 and contrast with -(으)므로.

#### Entradas relacionadas

Se relaciona con **-아/어서** de causa, **그래서** y otras formas que expresan razón, consecuencia o contraste.
